name: Do I need to rewrite all my website content for AI Overviews optimization?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to rewrite all my website content for AI Overviews optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: You may not need to rewrite all your content, but a strategic review and update are often necessary. Focus on optimizing existing high-value pages and creating new content where gaps exist. Prioritize clarity, direct answers to questions, and structured data. Content that is already well-researched, accurate, and organized can be adapted rather than completely rewritten, while less effective content might require more substantial changes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Not all content needs rewriting, but a strategic review and update are necessary. Focus on optimizing existing high-value pages and creating new, clear, and structured content where needed.
